notes: Trivial getter: mov eax, 0x836C64; ret. Returned pointer is the string literal at 0x836C64, so pointer identity matters (use CSF_STR with the same address).

name: C_00832e40_GetTFunctionRecargar
summary: Returns the constant string "TFunctionRecargar" identifying this type-function object.
notes: Trivial 6-byte function that just loads the address of the string constant at 0x00832ED8 into eax. Written as a __thiscall (ecx=this, unused) matching the virtual-method layout; no stack arguments, callee pops 0 bytes.

name: GetRecargandoString
summary: Returns a pointer to the constant string "TRecargando" (0x832470).
notes: Trivial 6-byte getter: mov eax, 0x832470; ret. CSF_STR expands to a reinterpret_cast expression, so it is used directly in the return statement rather than as a standalone binding.

name: C_00832bf8_GetCrouchModeName
summary: Returns a pointer to the constant string "TModoAgacharse" (crouch mode name).
notes: Trivial accessor: the disassembly only does `mov eax, 0x832c90; ret`. The `this` pointer (ecx) is never read. Exposed as a __thiscall-style member (__fastcall with unused edx, ret 0) since Hex-Rays attributes it to C_00832bf8.

name: C_00832d80_GetAttackActionName
summary: Returns a pointer to the constant action name string "TAtacar".
notes: Function is 6 bytes: mov eax, 0x832E18; ret 0. Treated as a __thiscall member (ecx=this, no stack args); could also be a plain cdecl/static getter with identical codegen. The exact original class role is unknown, so the class guess is speculative.
